We're deploying our internal AI assistant and need to set up the Nova permission system before going live. The system currently has a broken setup under nova-permission-system/data/ with incorrect config files, and the AGENTS.md has no security rules in it yet.

Please do the following:
1. Set up the correct data configuration files in /workspace/data/ — we need at minimum one owner user named 'Alice' (user_id: 'owner_001'), her platform account bound to our Feishu workspace (open_id: 'ou_alice_feishu_001', platform: 'feishu'), the full role permission configuration (we have three tiers: owner, friend, and stranger), a testing mode flag, a whitelist, and an empty approvals registry.
2. Update /workspace/AGENTS.md to include the mandatory security policy block.

Make sure the configuration is functionally correct — we'll test it by running the authentication module against Alice's account to verify she gets write access approved.
